text:
leo (Sales): Heads-up — MedicaCorp onboarding flagged as high-touch. They attached a SOC2 questionnaire and are asking for 7-year audit log retention + exportable, tamper-evident logs. Also want KMS rotation details and HIPAA scoping for PHI pathways.
anya (Product PM): Thanks. Do we have a precedent for 7-year retention? I thought our current retention tiers top at 3y.
sam (Support): We handled a long-retention ask last quarter but it was customer-managed archive. This one wants Redwood to retain and serve exports on demand.
frank (Security): :eyes: Storing 7y of logs in-hosted product is a compliance blocker without contract + additional controls. Need encryption-at-rest proof, key separation, and access log retention.
leo (Sales): Customer insists on Redwood-managed retention; they need SLA language for data availability and certified export process. Could we scope as an "onboarding exception" with additional fees?
anya (Product PM): Proposal: treat as a dedicated onboarding epic. Steps: triage questionnaire -> gap analysis -> security sign-off -> backlog epic -> implementation + docs + compliance checklist. Who owns the questionnaire answers?
sam (Support): I can own initial questionnaire answers and gather required artifacts. Will need frank to confirm KMS/HSM statements.
frank (Security): I can provide a standard KMS/HSM blurb and list of audit items. For long-term retention we need to define: storage class (WORM?), encryption key lifecycle, data deletion/latency SLA, and egress process.
ops-bot: deploy-notice: a new private-retention-epic ticket suggested.
anya (Product PM): Let's create a backlog ticket with acceptance criteria. Draft template: ```
- Epic: medica-high-touch-compliance-onboarding
- Acceptance criteria:
  - Completed SOC2 questionnaire answers submitted to customer
  - Documented retention design supporting 7y with export procedure
  - Security sign-off (frank)
  - Pricing + contract appendix drafted (sales)
  - Implementation plan with rollout dates and monitoring
```
leo (Sales): +1. Also need to map to SLA: availability for exports within 48 hours, and proof of integrity. Customer will insist on that.
frank (Security): 48h export SLA is OK if we add a contingency for emergency retrieval vs routine exports. We'll need an ops runbook.
anya (Product PM): Priority: high (sales closing depends). Proposed roadmap slot: Q2 backlog for triage + Q3 implementation depending on legal. If legal requires changes, we may push.
sam (Support): I'll open the ticket and attach the SOC2 PDF and customer's retention matrix. Assign to @anya and tag @frank.
leo (Sales): Thanks team. I'll negotiate contract appendix language to include cost and SLA. Keeping this thread for quick updates only — will DM for detailed docs. :thumbsup:
frank (Security): I'll drop the KMS/HSM statement and required audit checklist into the ticket by EOD.
anya (Product PM): Good. Next steps: sam opens ticket, frank attaches security artifacts, leo negotiates appendix, I'll scope effort & acceptance criteria and bring to PM triage on Tue.
sam (Support): Ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/RINF-8421 — added labels "high-touch", "compliance-onboarding", "retention-7y". Assigned to anya.
leo (Sales): Perfect. I'll reference that ticket in contract. Closing thread for now, update ticket for any follow-ups.
